steps.text: Spot the pattern! Find the next term in the multiplication sequence, and how many digits it has.
Tap the option you think is the next term in the sequence.
Type how many digits that term has into the digit box.
Tap the highlighted check button to test your answer.
Each step multiplies by the same amount — that's what makes the pattern grow.

coach.mission: Find the next term and its digit count.
whenStuck: Pick the next term, type its digit count, then “Check Pulse”.
Each step multiplies by the same amount — find that factor.
whenWrong: Find the constant multiplier between terms, apply it once more, then recount that term's digits.
Check your multiplication — the pattern grows by the same factor each time.
coach.done: You can extend multiplication patterns now. Keep going, or move on.
